name: Divisible Digit Sum
latex: \text{Find the smallest positive integer whose digits sum to } 20 \text{ and which is divisible by } 9.

name: Arithmetic Warm-Up
latex: \text{The 3rd term of an arithmetic sequence is } 11 \text{ and the 7th term is } 27. \text{ Find the 20th term.}

name: Right Triangle Altitude
latex: \text{In right triangle } ABC \text{ with the right angle at } C, \ AC = 6, \ BC = 8. \text{ Find the length of the altitude from } C \text{ to } AB.

name: Handshakes at the Table
latex: \text{Twelve people sit at a round table. Each person shakes hands with everyone except their two immediate neighbors. How many handshakes occur in total?}

name: Remainder Chase
latex: \text{Find the remainder when } 7^{100} \text{ is divided by } 12.

name: A Gentle Functional Equation
latex: \text{Find all functions } f: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R} \text{ such that } f(x+y) = f(x) + f(y) + xy \text{ for all real } x, y, \text{ given } f(1) = 2.

name: Tangent Circles Chain
latex: \text{Circle } \omega_1 \text{ of radius } 4 \text{ and circle } \omega_2 \text{ of radius } 9 \text{ are externally tangent. A common external tangent touches } \omega_1 \text{ at } P \text{ and } \omega_2 \text{ at } Q. \text{ Find } PQ.

name: Subset Sum Guarantee
latex: \text{Prove that among any } 10 \text{ integers chosen from } \{1, 2, \ldots, 100\}, \text{ some nonempty subset has a sum divisible by } 10.

name: AM-GM Squeeze
latex: \text{For positive reals } a, b, c \text{ with } abc = 1, \text{ prove that } a^2 + b^2 + c^2 \ge a + b + c.

name: The Elusive Triple
latex: \text{Determine all triples of positive integers } (x, y, z) \text{ satisfying } x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = 2(xy + yz + zx) - 3.

name: The Cyclic Quadrilateral Trap
latex: \text{Let } ABCD \text{ be a cyclic quadrilateral with } AC \cap BD = P. \text{ Prove that } PA \cdot PC = PB \cdot PD \text{ and use this to determine } AB \cdot CD + AD \cdot BC \text{ in terms of the diagonals and the circumradius.}

name: The Committee Graph
latex: \text{In a country with } 2023 \text{ cities, some pairs are connected by roads such that every city has degree at least } 1012. \text{ Prove the road network is connected.}
